full_judgment: 2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that the petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.112 of 2002 for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession of the land in Schedule No.2 to the plaint stating, inter cilia, that the suit land measuring an area of 1662 acre within Dag No.10195 appertaining to, Khatian No.6397, under Mutation Khatian No.6156 originally belonged to Keramotulla and the plaintiff-petitioner through several registered kabalas purchased the suit land from the recorded owners and obtained possession of the entire land situated in Dag No.10195. The suit land is surrounded by Dag No.10194 towards the eastern side and Dag No. 10196 towards the southern side. The land situated in the aforesaid two dags belonged to defendant Nos. 1-8. A pakka pillar was stationed in between Dag No.10196 and Dag No.10195 as a boundary line. During the 1st part of December, 2000, the defendants by force removed the pakka pillar and took possession in the land described in schedule-2 to the plaint and constructed a pakka boundary and thereby encroached .0884 acre of land from Plot No.10195 owned by the plain-tiff Hence the instant suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession.
